rule_or_requirement: Local candidates must finish the qualified line on at least as many matched cells as the selected control before a faster lap can justify advancement.
observable_information: At inference, four grayscale frames and pixel-only road, speed, and obstacle diagnostics; evaluator records finish, action, speed, road contact, and runtime.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Preserve frozen opening launch and fixed early pixel bend steering only; no added gas or braking.
expected_success_endpoint: On new tune cells, launch plus early steering finishes at least as often as launch-only control and on completion tie improves median finished lap time.
falsifier: Candidate-only nonfinish or lower completion, invalid action/resource breach, or no median lap improvement on completion tie.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Exact ZIP comparison on tracks 1-3 by seeds 7024-7027, 12 paired cells and 24 episodes, 2000 decisions each.
resource_and_risk_gate: Local Linux CPU 2 CPUs, 2 GiB, 1800 seconds; held-out 7028-7031 and confirmation 7032-7035 remain closed pending gates.
